author: Shan
title: CALL FOR ARTISTS! Looking for illustrators
content:
🎨 CALL FOR ARTISTS! ✨

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfVxoPW1iWD17f3FHlI0Je76LuBbT22Z1nAVMXF4WSGq_16Lg/viewform?usp=send_form

author: GNWT Environment and Climate Change
title: Commissioning original artwork for NWT regulations guides
content:
NWT artists: applications close this week!

There’s still time to submit your proposal to create original artwork for future editions of the NWT hunting and trapping and sport fishing regulations guides.

ECC is commissioning 10 original pieces representing wildlife, fish, landscapes and harvesting traditions from across the territory.

Artists can propose one or more pieces and identify the region and wildlife or fish species they would like to represent.

Applicants must live in the NWT

Proposals are due October 16, 2026

Don’t miss the deadline. Review the full call for artists and submit your proposal: https://t.co/EDtF9k6eDH
